Description.Name: Federated Suns Medal of Honor
Description.Details:
Darius clears his throat and reads from a formal AFFS dispatch.

"House Davion has awarded {CompanyName} the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_FederatedSunsMedalofHonor],Federated Suns Medal of Honor]] for service during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]]."

"The full citation is in your Decorations record, Commander. The Suns do not hand these out lightly."

Description.Name: Logged
Description.Details: The citation is entered in the company record. You can review decorations from the Captain's Quarters.
